what: The pipeline, one stage at a time
title: Alabama Pre-K tutorial: from the raw pipeline to reporting tables
text: cacs_run() orchestrates five functions sequence. first two reach network; last three pure local computation whatever two returned: cacs_acs_prefetch() (ACS download) → cacs_isochrone() (routing) → cacs_intersect_weight() → cacs_propagate_moe() → cacs_derive_rates(). section runs stage can see object moves — can lift stage standalone manuscript figure. live run fetch statewide ACS tracts draw drive-time isochrones like . forms shown reference executed , make network request: cacs_acs_prefetch() returns sf tibble tract-level ACS estimates (GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate, moe, geometry), cacs_isochrone() returns one drive-time polygon per (site_id, drive_time_min) pair. two bundled fixtures used exactly return shapes, frozen: sample_alabama_subset.rds stands ACS prefetch, legacy_2025_isochrones.rds stands isochrones. Loading lets us run rest pipeline network . ACS fixture carries 14 source variables across Alabama tracts EPSG:4269; isochrone fixture set drive-time polygons EPSG:4326. two coordinate systems cacs_intersect_weight() expects input. algorithmic heart package. cacs_intersect_weight() overlays isochrone ACS tracts, computes much tract falls inside catchment, aggregates source ACS counts overlap. runs fully offline: Two columns worth reading closely. n_tracts many tracts catchment touched — sample thickness. weight_sum sum tract area weights went aggregate; weight fraction tract’s area lying inside catchment, \text{coverage\_wt}_j = \text{area}(\text{catchment} \cap \text{tract}_j) / \text{area}(\text{tract}_j). catchments slice tract boundaries, weight_sum generally whole number — catchment covering three tracts edge fourth might sum something like 3.4. answer reviewer asks effective tract count integer: tracts enter partially, proportion much area drive-time area covers. “Estimand families weights” section ?cacs_intersect_weight documents full weighting scheme. short, count variables (spatial_total) use coverage weight directly, scalar proxy variables (median-income proxy, say) use separate normalized mean weight sums one within cell. function also attaches internal carrier table — coverage-weighted numerator denominator totals — next two stages read. ACS estimates ship published margins error (MOE), must travel weighting. cacs_propagate_moe() attaches MOE every row, choosing formula appropriate variable’s estimand family. pure computation: margin error half-width 90% confidence interval — report value estimate ± moe, exactly Census Bureau reports ACS figures. stage recompute point estimates; fills moe records, per row, formula used (moe_formula_effective) whether fallback needed (moe_fallback, moe_fallback_reason). re-derive formulas — four families never-silent fallback rule documented ?cacs_propagate_moe vignette("methodology", package = "catchmentACS"). One diagnostic habit: non-trivial moe_fallback_reason audit signal, error. records requested formula produce value cell (example zero denominator missing input MOE) run stays transparent. intentionally clean mini-batch fallback fires: Finally, cacs_derive_rates() appends five curated catchment rates new derived_rate rows beneath source-variable rows, ratio area-weighted ACS totals propagated MOE: rate maps ACS numerator/denominator pair policy reading: MOE formula rate selected cacs_derive_rates()’s formula_dispatch argument. package’s baseline policy, poverty_rate labor_force_participation C1-eligible (proportion_subset form, valid numerator true subset denominator), snap_rate, ssi_rate, unemp_rate routed C2 (general_ratio_conservative). C1 rate whose subset variance comes negative falls back C2 cell, override recorded moe_fallback, moe_fallback_reason, moe_formula_effective. full dispatch contract lives ?cacs_propagate_moe ?cacs_derive_rates.

These are exactly what stages 1 and 2 would have returned, frozen to disk. sites <- readRDS(system.file(   "extdata", "legacy_2025_sites.rds", package = "catchmentACS" )) acs <- readRDS(system.file(   "extdata", "sample_alabama_subset.rds", package = "catchmentACS" )) iso <- readRDS(system.file(   "extdata", "legacy_2025_isochrones.rds", package = "catchmentACS" ))  # title: Alabama Pre-K tutorial: from the raw pipeline to reporting tables
text: part matters hand-. Everything deliverable equity researcher can drop memo, dissertation chapter, journal submission — maps concrete reporting need. result one tidy long table — one row per site, drive-time band, variable — carrying provenance audit fields useful share results ignorable otherwise. daily analysis starts handful columns, name reuse selection. Read failure_origin first: "none" success flag cell. batch intentionally clean, every rate succeeds. larger live run, derived rate comes back NA, failure_origin names stage produced gap — upstream ACS input, isochrone failure, empty intersection, missing aggregation carrier — can diagnose rather guess. estimate rate proportion: 0.173 means 17.3%. compact deliverable one row per site drive time five curated rates side side. Pivoting long table wide gives exactly shape manuscript table: analyst’s primary worktable: every site every catchment band, five rates columns. reader-facing version pairs rate uncertainty, summary() reshapes numbers one row per site drive time, rate formatted estimate ± MOE: <NA> cell appears larger run, formatting error: means package form stable numerator/denominator pair rate cell. Keep cells visible review tables rather overwriting zero — missing rate diagnostic, absence need. common policy task rank sites need widest catchment. sort three sites 15-minute poverty rate, highest first — kind ordering drives “invest next” conversation. estimate stays proportion; multiply 100 final formatting step downstream arithmetic remains stable. Swap poverty_rate snap_rate unemp_rate rank different indicator, change drive_time_min compare priorities tighter band. single-site memo question different: “site ranks highest?” “one site change catchment grows 5 15 minutes?” profile shows five curated rates across three rings one focal site, margin error implied confidence interval. Reporting rate estimate ± moe_90 ([ci_low, ci_high] interval shown ) convention Census Bureau uses ACS figures, reviewer can read catchment numbers exactly read published table. Finally, reduce object clean, CSV-ready table. Keep MOE, failure flag, effective MOE formula alongside estimate reviewer can trace uncertainty fallback behavior. write , example, readr::write_csv(export_tbl, "alabama_prek_rates.csv"). publishing narrative claim, filter flag rows failure_origin != "none": missing rate may still useful diagnostic, must read zero.

code: # Focal site point and its 15-minute ring (both EPSG:4326). focal_pt   <- analysis_sites[analysis_sites$site_id == focal_site, ] focal_ring <- iso[iso$site_id == focal_site & iso$drive_time_min == 15, ]  # Build a tract-level poverty rate from the source ACS counts, then keep only # the tracts the 15-minute ring touches. Everything stays offline. suppressMessages(sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE))  pov <- acs |>   sf::st_drop_geometry() |>   filter(variable %in% c("B17001_001", "B17001_002")) |>   select(GEOID, variable, estimate) |>   tidyr::pivot_wider(     id_cols = GEOID, names_from = variable, values_from = estimate   ) |>   transmute(GEOID, poverty_rate = B17001_002 / B17001_001)  tract_geom <- acs |>   filter(variable == "B17001_001") |>   select(GEOID) |>   left_join(pov, by = "GEOID") |>   sf::st_transform(4326)  hit <- tract_geom[   sf::st_intersects(tract_geom, focal_ring, sparse = FALSE)[, 1], ]  pal <- leaflet::colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = hit$poverty_rate)  leaflet::leaflet(hit) |>   leaflet::addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>   leaflet::addPolygons(     fillColor = ~pal(poverty_rate), fillOpacity = 0.6,     weight = 0.5, color = "#666666",     label = ~sprintf("Tract %s: %.1f%%", GEOID, 100 * poverty_rate)   ) |>   leaflet::addPolygons(     data = focal_ring, fill = FALSE,     weight = 2, opacity = 0.8, color = "#c05621"   ) |>   leaflet::addCircleMarkers(     data = focal_pt, radius = 5, color = "#2b6cb0",     fillOpacity = 0.9, stroke = FALSE, popup = ~site_id   ) |>   leaflet::addLegend(     pal = pal, values = ~poverty_rate,     title = "Tract poverty rate",     labFormat = leaflet::labelFormat(transform = function(x) 100 * x, suffix = "%")   )

title: Methodology: the pipeline as an estimator

Concretely, site s: Sites → catchments. Take drive-time isochrone polygon I_s (drawn fresh, reused precomputed polygons) ACS tract polygons T_j. Catchments → tract overlaps. Cut intersections I_s \cap T_j equal-area projection, intersection build weight describing much tract j catchment captures. Overlaps → estimates. Aggregate tract-level estimate Y_j (X_j) catchment weight matches variable’s estimand family. Estimates → margins error. Propagate published tract-level MOEs weights. Estimates → rates. Form curated derived rates ratios aggregated numerators denominators, propagated MOE. single function cacs_run() chains stages; five pipeline functions expose one . title: Porting catchmentACS workflows to v0.4
text: v0.3, cacs_isochrone(sites_sf, 10L, "osrm") res omitted often resolved res = 70L demo server, frequently triggered HTTP 429 quota-exhaustion abort. v0.4, osrm_mode = "demo" (default) res omitted, call auto-downgrades res = 30L emits -per-session classed message. lowers public-demo quota pressure, depending endpoint’s state may still hit 429 transient failure. public routing.openstreetmap.de demo server, pre-flight helper uses profile-prefixed public-demo route path, e.g. /routed-car/route/v1/driving/.... Self-hosted OSRM endpoints keep standard /route/v1/driving/... probe path. returned endpoint column configured base server, internally expanded probe URL.
code: # v0.4 default: 30L on demo (lower public-demo quota pressure), 70L on docker. iso <- cacs_isochrone(sites_sf, 10L, "osrm")  # demo by default -> res = 30L  # Need the v0.3 res = 70L polygon quality? Request it explicitly: iso_hi <- cacs_isochrone(sites_sf, 10L, "osrm", res = 70L)  # Or use a local OSRM container (no quota cost): iso_dk <- cacs_isochrone(sites_sf, 10L, "osrm", osrm_mode = "docker")  # 70L state <- cacs_validate_osrm_endpoint() if (state$quota_ok) {   iso <- cacs_isochrone(sites_sf, 10L, "osrm") } else if (identical(state$http_status, 429L)) {   message("OSRM demo saturated; switching to docker.")   iso <- cacs_isochrone(sites_sf, 10L, "osrm", osrm_mode = "docker") } else {   message("OSRM probe inconclusive or unavailable; inspect state$http_status.") } options(catchmentACS.osrm_demo_budget_protect = FALSE) iso <- cacs_isochrone(sites_sf, 10L, "osrm")  # back to v0.3 res = 70L behavior

what: Change 3 – ACS preflight is stricter and safer
title: Porting catchmentACS workflows to v0.5
text: cacs_acs_prefetch() tightened three behaviors: End years pinned 2009-2024. release verifies ACS5 support window. year outside aborts clear range message instead attempting unverified Census endpoint. Fractional years rejected. non-integer year (e.g. 2023.5) now aborts asking whole-number year, rather silently truncating . cache checked Census key required. cache hit (explicit acs = bypass cacs_run()) served CENSUS_API_KEY. live cache miss force_refresh = TRUE requires key tidycensus metadata data call. v0.4 script passed --window fractional year, round supported whole-number year. See ?cacs_acs_prefetch cache live-access sections.
code: # Cache hit or explicit `acs =` bypass: no Census key needed. acs_cached <- cacs_acs_prefetch(state = "AL", year = 2023)   # served from cache  # Live miss or force_refresh = TRUE: a CENSUS_API_KEY is required first. acs_fresh <- cacs_acs_prefetch(state = "AL", year = 2023, force_refresh = TRUE)  # Rejected in v0.5 (these abort rather than guess): # cacs_acs_prefetch(state = "AL", year = 2025)     # outside 2009-2024 # cacs_acs_prefetch(state = "AL", year = 2023.5)   # fractional year

what: Why MOE propagation needs its own algebra
title: MOE propagation: margins of error
text: Every ACS estimate ships published margin error, catchment estimate function many estimates — weighted sum tract counts, weighted blend tract scalars, ratio two aggregated totals. published MOEs describe uncertainty inputs; question article answers uncertainty travels output. Dropping option: coverage-weighted count persons poverty margin error invites false precision underlying survey never claimed. title: Propagate margins of error across catchment ACS estimates — cacs_propagate_moe
text: four supported formula families documented detail .

title: Propagate margins of error across catchment ACS estimates — cacs_propagate_moe
text: Standard errors (SE) margins error interconvertible confidence multiplier \(z\): \(M = z \cdot SE\), \(z = 1.645\) default 90% level. Variances accumulate SE scale, formula divides component MOEs \(z\), combines resulting variances, multiplies combined SE back \(z\). Family – spatial total / weighted sum counts. coverage-weighted sum independent ACS counts, MOE root-sum-square weighted component MOEs: $$M = z \sqrt{\sum_j \left(\frac{w_j M_j}{z}\right)^2}$$ Family B – weighted scalar/proxy mean. proxy mean built area- population-normalized weights (e.g. median-income proxy), root-sum-square form applies mean weights, sum one treated fixed: $$M = z \sqrt{\sum_j \left(\frac{w_j M_j}{z}\right)^2}$$ Family C1 – proportion subset. numerator \(\) true subset denominator \(B\), cross term subtracted: $$\widehat{Var}(/B) \approx \frac{Var() - (/B)^2\, Var(B)}{B^2}$$ expression can go negative; , row falls back Family C2 formula (see ) value still produced. Family C2 – general ratio (conservative). default package's hard-coded derived rates, used whenever subset relationship guaranteed. cross term added, variance always non-negative: $$\widehat{Var}(/B) \approx \frac{Var() + (/B)^2\, Var(B)}{B^2}$$ C1 C2 fallback. fallback never silent. Family C1 row yields negative subset variance, MOE recomputed Family C2 formula override recorded per row: moe_formula_effective becomes "general_ratio_conservative", moe_fallback set TRUE, moe_fallback_reason set "negative_variance". zero denominator missing input MOE instead yields NA moe_fallback_reason "zero_denominator" "missing_moe". Rows computed without fallback carry moe_fallback = FALSE moe_fallback_reason = "n/". single summary warning reports fallback counts end run. formula applied row can overridden formula argument, confidence multiplier level.

text: verbose progress reporter covers three long-running steps (cacs_isochrone(), cacs_acs_prefetch(), cacs_intersect_weight()). orchestrator also propagates progress cacs_propagate_moe() cacs_derive_rates() one summary condition per call. reporter three modes, auto-selected per call: silent – progress output . bookend – start + end summary (per-event tick); used small batches single-shot ACS prefetch (N = 1). bar – per-tick classed condition monotone ETA + rate, CI-safe via rlang::inform() cli formatting (cli_progress_step()). Resolution follows 5-rule priority chain (highest first): (1) verbose = FALSE -> silent; (2) Sys.getenv("CACS_QUIET") == "1" -> silent; (3) getOption("catchmentACS.progress") == "" -> silent, "force" -> bar, "auto" (default) -> fall ; (4) N < 5 -> bookend; (5) N >= 5 -> bar. N axis per-iteration (sites cacs_isochrone(), (site, drive_time) pairs cacs_intersect_weight(), fixed 1 cacs_acs_prefetch(), cacs_propagate_moe(), cacs_derive_rates()). Ticks emit classed conditions (catchmentACS_message_progress_tick / catchmentACS_message_progress_summary) downstream capture via withCallingHandlers() works without coupling cli internals. Global toggles: Disable everywhere: Sys.setenv(CACS_QUIET = "1") options(catchmentACS.progress = ""). Force bar N (including N = 1): options(catchmentACS.progress = "force"). Restore auto (default): options(catchmentACS.progress =         "auto") options(catchmentACS.progress = NULL). cacs_run(verbose = TRUE) forwards progress reporting five sub-calls. Warnings still route phase-keyed aggregation contract, progress messages remain ordinary classed messages downstream callers can catch catchmentACS_message_progress.

Three safety nets guard : per-call rate_first = FALSE opt-, global catchmentACS.rate_first_default = FALSE opt-, migration notice.

text: Prepared default ACS variable catalogue SSI formula fix adding B19056_002 (ssi_hh, households Supplemental Security Income) retaining B19056_001 (ssi_total), B11001_001, B23025_001. Critical: Corrected ssi_rate B19056_001 / B11001_001 B19056_002 / B19056_001, now measures households Supplemental Security Income B19056 household universe instead dividing two total-household rows. five sanctioned rate formulas audited ACS 2023 B-table labels. Added opt-derived-rate audit warnings via options(catchmentACS.audit_rates = TRUE). --range diagnostic values emit catchmentACS_warning_rate_out_of_range; audit warning-default. Locked five sanctioned rate formulas hand-computed golden tests, SSI-specific regression tests, default-carrier -NA checks, provenance/audit assertions, env-gated three-site SSI live-smoke test. Refreshed inst/extdata/sample_alabama_subset.rds 14-variable v0.3 default ACS catalogue examples fixtures include new SSI numerator carrier. Closed carrier-missing default-path regression: default ACS catalogue now covers every sanctioned rate numerator denominator, direct/custom pipelines omit carrier emit catchmentACS_warning_carrier_missing limiting NA output affected derived-rate row. Added offline replay fixtures v0.2 walkthroughs, including cache-poison annulus-input fixtures regression tests.

title: catchmentACS 0.3.0
text: Critical: Test-fixture ACS cache poisoning now structurally isolated: test namespace mode writes ACS entries acs_test/, production reads use acs/ never fall back acs_test/. Critical: Intersect cache keys now hash current acs_sf content, changed ACS estimates geometry silently reuse stale weighted output even upstream provenance keys row counts unchanged. Added v0.3 cache fingerprint sidecars. Every persisted cache entry now writes sibling <key>.fingerprint metadata file using sha256; missing legacy sidecars, malformed sidecars, corrupt RDS files, digest mismatches invalidate cache miss instead returning stale data. Added cacs_set_cache() cacs_get_cache_state() session/global cache opt-, diagnostics, namespace status, hit/miss counters. Hardened cache payload identity: isochrone keys now 16-dimensional ring_topology; intersect keys now 14-dimensional iso_ring_topology, iso_res_param, content-aware ACS input hashing. Added catchmentACS_warning_cache_stale_suspect suspicious ACS cache hits clear cache recovery recipe. Tune options(catchmentACS.stale_threshold_rows = 1000L), disable 0L, override state, e.g. options(catchmentACS.stale_threshold_WY = 500L). Added 39 bug-grade cache regression tests #10, #11, v0.2 legacy cache invalidation, cache API behavior, cross-namespace integration.

title: catchmentACS 0.3.0
text: Water-tract filtering now emits catchmentACS_message_water_tract_filter interactive non-interactive Rscript sessions. Cached ACS hits written v0.3 condition metadata replay water-filter condition cache use hide dropped GEOIDs. Progress reporting now emits classed catchmentACS_message_progress_tick catchmentACS_message_progress_summary conditions Rscript. Large batches throttle tick conditions via options(catchmentACS.progress_throttle = N) preserving final tick. cacs_run(verbose = TRUE) now forwards verbose five sub-calls. ACS prefetch, isochrone, intersect/weight, MOE propagation, rate derivation expose progress summary conditions. Added internal .cacs_emit() classed emit helper. Messages warnings formatted cli signaled rlang::inform() / rlang::warn(), making condition class tree stable capture contract. Added exported cacs_capture_conditions(expr, classes = NULL), returns tibble captured catchmentACS conditions class, message, phase, timestamp, call. Added ?catchmentACS-conditions, top-level help page current condition class tree, custom handlers, muting/capture patterns. Added cacs_intersect_weight(keep_tract_audit = FALSE). TRUE, returned weighted long tibble carries attr(, "cacs_tract_audit"), six-column per-tract audit table (site_id, drive_time_min, GEOID, area_wt, int_area_m2, tract_area_m2). default keeps ordinary outputs audit-free.

title: catchmentACS 0.3.0
text: Root-caused 117 s/site OSRM cold-path slowdown upstream osrm::osrmIsochrone() public-demo request budget: res = 70L, routing.openstreetmap.de implies 4,900 grid destinations, 66 table chunks, 65 seconds forced sleep per site network geometry overhead. Made OSRM endpoint/profile resolution explicit cache-keyed. osrm_mode = "docker" path now resolves local OSRM endpoint default (http://0.0.0.0:5000/, overrideable) emits catchmentACS_message_perf_fix_applied fast-server path avoids public-demo forced-sleep budget. Added OSRM request-budget provenance cacs_isochrone() outputs users can diagnose whether cold-run time dominated public demo endpoint geometry/workflow choices. Added cacs_get_cache_state()$counters[[1]], public three-row hit/miss diagnostic table (isochrone, acs, intersect) hit rates namespace-scoped reset behavior cacs_clear_cache() called. Added deterministic performance-boundary tests OSRM request budgets, fast-path endpoint provenance, warm-cache cacs_run() behavior, cache-counter overhead, geometry byte identity. Live OSRM timing remains env-gated diagnostic public demo endpoint intentionally classified -budget res = 70L.

title: catchmentACS 0.3.0
text: cacs_plot_site_rates() cacs_plot_site_pipeline() now honor documented direct (lat, lon) input form resolving coordinates nearest available site_id run_result. Resolutions emit catchmentACS_message_resolve_site; matches 5 km away also emit catchmentACS_warning_resolve_site_distant. Documented per-urbanicity isochrone area-divergence expectations: urban sites stay tight, mid-density sites get moderate headroom, sparse rural sites interpreted tract-membership/Jaccard checks raw polygon-area divergence treated bug. Locked urbanicity interpretation fixture-backed urban/mid/rural area-tolerance bands seam-mode tract Jaccard checks, including Greene County documented rural outlier rather downstream aggregation bug. Narrowed internal sf planar-CRS noise handling around catchmentACS-managed intersection calls preserving caller-facing classed warnings geometry skips provenance hints. Added exported cacs_summary_as_markdown() stable Quarto/GitHub pipe-Markdown rendering summary(cacs_run(...)) breakdown tables without coupling tibble’s terminal-width internals. Added cacs_describe() read-provenance map cacs_run_result, long weighted/propagated/derived tibbles, isochrone/ACS sf objects, output = "" result lists. helper reports schema, carrier, MOE, rate, cache, spatial provenance without mutating object. Added cacs_validate_iso() non-aborting preflight helper v0.3 isochrone schema issues, rewrote highest-friction schema/plot validator messages concrete fix hints copy-paste examples. Expanded vignette("porting-v01--v03") v0.3 migration guide, including executable examples eight v0.1 -> v0.2 script-side transitions v0.2 -> v0.3 topology/cache/formula/API changes. Added schema verification offline integration tests live-OSRM smoke gate; cacs_run(precomputed_isochrones = ...) now validates resolved isochrone schema reading canonical status columns.

title: catchmentACS 0.2.0
text: print.cacs_run_result() – rich cli-formatted output provider, drive_times, site counts, top-3 rates mean +/- MOE, dropped water GEOIDs count, wall-clock. summary.cacs_run_result() – returns classed cacs_run_summary list per-rate mean / sd / n_NA, n_tracts fivenum, MOE-fallback coverage rate. print.cacs_run_summary() – structured summary display. 11 metadata fields accessible via attr(, "cacs_run_result_metadata"): generated_at, cacs_version, provider, profile, drive_times, n_sites_total / success / failed, wall_clock_seconds, skipped_geoids, moe_fallback_summary (last carrying c1_to_c2_count, zero_den_count, missing_moe_count). breaking change: v0.1 workflows (cacs_run(...) %>% filter(...), ggplot(...), write_csv(...), View(...)) work unchanged. print method defensively degrades generic tibble preview metadata attribute stripped upstream dplyr verb.

title: catchmentACS 0.2.0
text: Critical: cacs_acs_prefetch() now auto-drops water/special-purpose tracts (GEOID pattern 99xxxx + degenerate-area fallback) default; new arg drop_water_tracts = TRUE. Emits inform message (condition class catchmentACS_message_water_tract_filter) listing dropped GEOIDs (capped 5). cacs_intersect_weight() validator demoted error warn--skip degenerate-area tracts (condition class catchmentACS_warning_geometry_skip); preserves fail-loud catchmentACS_error_geometry tracts degenerate. Skipped GEOIDs available via attr(result, "skipped_geoids"). Fixes water-tract filtering bug water tract 01003990000 aborted Baldwin Co. catchment computations. Concrete impact: new default filter catches least two known Alabama water tracts tigris::tracts("AL", year = 2023) — 01003990000 (Baldwin Co. coastal) 01097990000 (Mobile Co. coastal) — previously aborted area-weighted intersection.
